summary_en: WITZ Corporation declared a commemorative dividend of 3 yen per share in addition to the ordinary dividend of 18 yen per share for the fiscal year ending August 31, 2026, bringing total dividend to 21 yen, marking the company's 30th business anniversary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, WITZ Corporation announced a dividend of 21 yen per share for the fiscal year ending August 31, 2026. The total consists of an ordinary dividend of 18 yen per share and a commemorative dividend of 3 yen per share. The dividend will be paid from retained earnings with an effective date of November 26, 2026.

The company stated that the commemorative dividend was decided to express gratitude to shareholders as the company marks its 30th business anniversary. The company attributed this milestone to the support and cooperation of shareholders and related parties. The total dividend amount is 83,986 thousand yen.
